basin_is_global.method: ten ILP infeasibility proofs, d = 0..9; d=10 unresolved in 900s
basin_is_global.statement: every 52-point partial ovoid of W(3,9), if one exists, meets our 51-set in at most 41 points
basin_is_global.still_not_a_bound: a 52-set far from S remains possible
basin_is_global.why_the_wall_is_structural: a point outside S can join only if all its S-neighbours are removed, so only points with tangent <= d are candidates; the maximum tangent at q=9 is 10, so at d=10 the restriction is vacuous

boundary: alpha(W(3,9)) is NOT determined; 51 <= alpha <= 73 stands. LNS is measured 6/6 reliable at q=7 where the answer is known, converges with the same signature at q=9, and has NOT converged at q=11 or q=13 -- so 65 and 83 are weak lower bounds that must not be used to fit a formula

spectral_dead_end.verdict: spectral bounds are WORSE than Tallini at both q, because the SRG ratio bound is q^2+1; only the ILP dual bound can beat Tallini
